name: The Test: Secrets of the Soul 2
source:
You will answer a series of questions that will reveal things from deep within. These questions may make you uncomfortable, but with great knowledge comes great sacrifice. Can you make it all the way through The Test, and if you do, are you sure you want the answers you seek?

Once again, it is time to dive deeper than ever before to unlock The Secrets of the Soul...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2349550/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你将回答一系列问题，揭示内心深处的事情。这些问题可能会让你感到不舒服，但知识渊博就会带来巨大的牺牲。你能通过测试吗？如果你能通过，你确定想要得到你所寻求的答案吗？

是时候再一次比以往更深入地探索灵魂的秘密了……

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2349550/]Steam[/url]]
